import json,pathlib,re,sys
label,pid,shell=sys.argv[1:];pid=int(pid)
path=pathlib.Path('trace-'+label)
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in path.read_text().splitlines()]
for row in rows:
 assert row['reply']=='errno:22',row
 if row.get('arg1')==pid:row['arg1']='owned'
path.write_text(json.dumps(rows,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
err=pathlib.Path('err-'+label)
text=err.read_text().replace(shell,'$SHELL')
text=re.sub(r'(?<=\(pid )'+str(pid)+r'(?=\))','OWNED_PID',text)
err.write_text(text)
print('calls='+str(len(rows)))
